workarounds.symptom: [1.0.3-rc] pull's insufficient-disk message suggests --force-disk-check, but pull rejects that flag
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): accept --force-disk-check on pull and chat. Target files: rapid_mlx/cli.py, rapid_mlx/cli_parser.py, tests/fixtures/cli_parser_snapshot.json. When a download does not fit on disk, the error tells the user to bypass the check with `--force-disk-check`, but `pull` and `chat` rejected the flag (`unrecognized arguments`). (Ref: https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX/pull/5754)

workarounds.symptom: A full disk during a catalog-model download is reported as a mirror/integrity failure (or a traceback), not out-of-disk
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(models): report out-of-disk during a mirror-only download. Target files: rapid_mlx/_mirror.py, rapid_mlx/cli.py, tests/test_mirror_disk_full.py. **Why:** When the model cache filesystem fills during a catalog-model download, users were told the mirror could not verify the files and to restore Hub access (or `serve` printed a raw `MirrorOnlyPullError` traceback). Nothing named the real cause, so users retried downloads that could not succeed. (Ref: https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX/pull/5746)

workarounds.symptom: Anthropic /v1/messages rejects redacted_thinking blocks in assistant history with a 400
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(anthropic): accept redacted_thinking blocks in assistant history. Target files: rapid_mlx/api/anthropic_adapter.py, rapid_mlx/api/anthropic_models.py, tests/test_anthropic_redacted_thinking.py. **Why:** Clients that resume a session send prior assistant turns back verbatim, including `redacted_thinking` blocks. That block type was missing from the accepted set, so `/v1/messages` (stream and non-stream) and `count_tokens` returned 400 for the entire request and the session could not continue. (Ref: https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX/pull/5743)

workarounds.symptom: Anthropic /v1/messages: tool_choice pinned to a tool 422s or streams a mid-stream error with no tool_use when the model answers in text
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(anthropic): force pinned and any tool_choice through generation. Target files: rapid_mlx/api/anthropic_adapter.py, rapid_mlx/routes/anthropic.py, tests/test_anthropic_generation_forcing.py. - `/v1/messages` `tool_choice: {"type":"tool"}` and `{"type":"any"}` now constrain generation through the same tool grammar + forced-prefix path as chat completions, instead of trying to synthesize an empty call (which failed for tools with required arguments). - `disable_parallel_tool_use` maps to single-call output. - Forced s... (Ref: https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX/pull/5724)
